sources.excerpt: OD850 Muff Fuzz Ram's Head – Stomp Under Foot Skip to content Search Search Cart PRODUCTS CONTACT FAQ DEALERS ARTISTS ABOUT BLOG Skip to product information 18% off Previous Next Close OVERDRIVE 8-FIFTY VINTAGE MINI Sale price $229.99 Regular price $279.99 By Stomp Under Foot Quantity Add to cart Based on the rare, final version of the Ibanez OD-850/OD-9, released as the OD-850 from 1980 to 1981 and later as the OD-9 from 1982 to 1984. This version features a modified Ram's Head inspired circuit with a reworked tone section and increased output. The result is a fuller, more balanced sound that retains its body as the tone control is turned up, along with smooth, harmonically rich gain that delivers classic sustain while preserving clarity and note definition.
